programme.desc: An exploration of two cases that changed the Scottish legal system forever. First up is the 37-year fight for justice following the murders of Christine Eadie and Helen Scott, aka the World's End murders, and subsequent trials of Angus Sinclair, accused of murdering the young women. Then it's an unremarkable case from the east end of Glasgow which ended up at the UK Supreme Court, resulting in huge consequences for the Scottish justice system.
